-- Email no users: limiransafg@gmail.com (minúsculo)
-- Email no allowed_clients: Limiransafg@gmail.com (com L maiúsculo)
-- Verificar se a busca por email é case-sensitive

SELECT 
  ac.id AS client_id,
  ac.email AS email_allowed_clients,
  ac.is_active,
  u.email AS email_users,
  u.id AS user_id,
  BINARY ac.email = BINARY u.email AS emails_identicos_case_sensitive,
  LOWER(ac.email) = LOWER(u.email) AS emails_identicos_case_insensitive
FROM allowed_clients ac
JOIN users u ON LOWER(u.email) = LOWER(ac.email)
WHERE LOWER(ac.email) = 'limiransafg@gmail.com';
